newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Final Cimpor sale details expected Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: Final Cimpor sale details expected Oct 3.

text.p: The government will decide on how much of the planned float of 45 percent of state-controlled cement-maker Cimpor will be offered to institutional investors at a cabinet meeting on October 3, a senior official at one of the advising banks told a news conference.
The privatisation gets underway with a pre-registration period on September 23 and ends with the announcement of the price and the allocation of shares on the Lisbon bourse on October 15.

But the government has still to announce how much will be offered on the bourse, including to small investors and employees, in a public offer to sell (OPV) and how much will be placed directly with domestic and international institutional investors.
"Everything points to (a decision) on October 3," the representative of Banco de Fomento & Exterior told journalists.
Following the privatisation, Cimpor stock will be quoted on London's SEAQ International and as American Depository Receipts (ADRs) on Wall Street.
According to BFE officials, the split between domestic and international investors is likely to be 40-45 percent for the national investors and 55-60 percent for the foreign investors.
The volume of stock to be offered in the direct sale could eventually be reduced by 15 percent if demand at the OPV is very strong.
